findings.claim: Moving the worktree-table kind/base filter client-side made the header select-all checkbox (and any row checked before a filter change) select rows the active filter hides, so Remove / Remove Worktree acts on worktrees and branches the user filtered out of view. At base the filter was server-side (rows outside the filter were never rendered), so select-all could only ever pick visible rows.
findings.evidence: Re-read at 1f725ce: repo_detail.html:65-72 — the select-all change handler runs document.querySelectorAll('input[name="branch"]').forEach(box.checked = e.target.checked) over every row; applyFilter (repo_detail.html:100-118) only sets row.hidden and never unchecks; the remove forms post hx-include="#op-force, input[name=branch]:checked" (_worktree_status.html:65-75), which serializes checked boxes regardless of row visibility; handleRepoRemoveSelected (repos.go:470-494) removes every posted branch. Base b4981b8 repos.go:376-380 filtered data.Statuses by matchesBase && matchesKind server-side, so hidden rows did not exist in the DOM. Sequence: open /repos/x?kind=claude-routines, tick select-all, click Remove → every claude/* row that is safe (or every row with force) is removed and its branch deleted although only claude-routines/* rows were shown. Mitigation only: refresh() builds the hx-confirm text from all checked rows, so the count/branch list in the dialog exceeds the visible rows. No spec item introduces the client-side filter; spec-11 lists filter chips under 'Must not change'.
findings.fix: Scope select-all to visible rows (document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-kind]:not([hidden]) input[name="branch"]')) and have applyFilter uncheck the box of every row it hides, then call refresh().

findings.claim: After an optimistic removal empties the table with no filter active, the page shows 'No agent branches matching the active filter.' although no filter is set.
findings.evidence: Re-read at 1f725ce: repo_detail.html:80-90 marks removed rows data-removed and hidden; applyFilter (100-118) runs on htmx:afterSettle (the op-result swap) and counts data-removed rows as hidden, so visible == 0 while tr[data-kind] still exists → wt-filter-empty is unhidden; its text (_worktree_status.html:150) asserts an active filter. Sequence: no ?kind/?base, select all safe rows, Remove, clean run (no repo-op re-scan) → the filter message appears.
findings.fix: Unhide wt-filter-empty only when kind or base is set (empty.hidden = visible > 0 || !(kind || base) || !document.querySelector('tr[data-kind]')).
